action.instructions: Which one action does the appliance take for the user's words? Each option is a whole action on what the appliance itself holds: what is playing, the music, the app, what it knows. Choose page when the words are about something on the page open. Choose none when the words are not a command.

options.play: music: find a song or video by the words and play it now, on YouTube or on this site as the words point — never the page's play button, which is a click
options.play_next: music: find a song by the words and play it after the one playing
options.queue: music: find a song by the words and add it to the end of the queue
options.say_time: appliance: say the time and date — 11:43, Tuesday 27 October
options.say_weather: appliance: say today's weather in London, the home city — words naming another place or a website are a search, not this — London: 15°C, clear sky now; today high 17°C, low 10°C, rain 98%; coming hours 12:00 15°C, 13:00 15°C, 14:00 15°C, 15:00 16°C, 16:00 15°C, 17:00 14°C; coming days 2026-10-28 15°C/9°C overcast, rain 6%, 2026-10-29 13°C/10°C overcast, rain 0%, 2026-10-30 14°C/9°C fog, rain 0%
options.say_playing: appliance: say the song playing — nothing playing
options.say_timer: appliance: say how long is left on the timer — no timer set
options.panel_open: app: open the activity panel, the feed of what was said and done — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_close: app: close the activity panel, hiding it — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_overlay: app: float the activity panel over the page — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_docked: app: dock the activity panel beside the page, in its own room — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.panel_width: app: change the activity panel's width: wider, narrower or to the pixels the words carry, the amount Choice saying which and how far — now closed, overlay, 536 px wide
options.show_idle: app: bring the Idle Screen back over the browser, music playing on — now showing the browser
options.show_dashboard: app: show the app's own home screen, the browser, leaving Settings or the Weight page — not a website's home page — now showing the browser
options.show_weight: app: show the Weight page, the weigh-ins — now showing the browser

options.settings: app setting: change one of the app's settings — ad blocking, appearance (light or dark mode), the clock (12- or 24-hour), seconds on the clock, the date format, the first day of the week, the idle timeout, night dimming, web page zoom, the weather city and units, the voice, the Idle Screen's cards, the upload folder
options.timer: the app: set a timer for the length the words say
options.timer_off: the app: turn the timer off
options.flag: the app: mark the last thing it did as a failure, for its makers to look at — the words after it, if any, are the hint
options.help: the app: show and say what it can be asked to do
options.stop: stop what the app is doing: the page loading, the voice speaking
options.page: something on the page open, "The Most Viewed TikTok Video: An Editor’s Deep Dive": its links, buttons, fields or text

amount.instructions: Only when the action skips forward or back in a video or audio, changes its volume or speed, or changes an app number (a setting's amount, the panel's width): how far? For a skip, choose words when the words say how far — a number of seconds, or of minutes; otherwise the share of its length the words mean. For a volume, a speed or an app number, choose to when the words carry the level, else up or down and how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as far as the words say: the number they carry, in seconds, or in minutes when they say minutes
options.moment: a moment: a hundredth of its length
options.little: a little: a twentieth of its length
options.chunk: a chunk: a tenth of its length
options.lot: a lot: a quarter of its length
options.end: all the way: to the end, or back to the start
options.to: the volume, speed or app number to the number the words carry
options.up-little: the volume, speed or app number up a little
options.up-step: the volume, speed or app number up a step
options.up-lot: the volume, speed or app number up a lot
options.up-all: the volume, speed or app number up as far as it goes
options.down-little: the volume, speed or app number down a little
options.down-step: the volume, speed or app number down a step
options.down-lot: the volume, speed or app number down a lot
options.down-all: the volume, speed or app number down as far as it goes

where.instructions: Where do the words point: at something on this page, at something on insideeditors.com that is not on this page, or somewhere else on the web?

options.page: on this page: one of the numbered refs
options.site: on insideeditors.com but not on this page: a page, a person, a post, a section of it
options.web: elsewhere: another website, or a search of the whole web

kind.instructions: When the action plays something by the words: is it music to listen to, or a video to watch? Music is a song, an artist or an album; a video is a creator's or a channel's video, one the words name, or music the words ask to see.

options.video: a video: show it playing on the screen
